questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

26 ∶ 6 ∶∶ ? ∶ 11 ∶∶ 37 ∶ 7

Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 26
 19
 12
 
 

 32
 ?
 16
 
 

 23
 20
 17
questions.solution:
**Logic : The pattern followed here is row wise.**

**(First number + Third number) ÷ 2 = Second number **

So,

 
• First row :

​(26 + 12 ) ÷ 2 = 19

38 ÷ 2 = 19

19 = 19 (LHS = RHS)

 
• Third row :

(23 + 17) ÷ 2 = 20

40 ÷ 2 = 20

20 = 20 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 
• Second row :

​(32 + 16) ÷ 2 = ?

48 ÷ 2 = ?

**? = 24**

Hence, **"24"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Eight girls, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting in two lines, with four girls in each line. Both the lines are facing the same direction. One line is behind the other line. K is at a corner and to the immediate left of P. O is to the immediate left of M. Two persons are sitting between K and R. L is just behind P. O is between L and M. N is not in the front line. Who is sitting between P and R?
questions.solution:
**Given : **

 
• **Eight girls - K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R**
 
• **They are sitting in two lines, with four girls in each line. **
 
• **Both the lines are facing the same direction.**
 
• **One line is behind the other line.**

**​Explanation :**

1) K is at a corner and to the immediate left of P. 

2) Two persons are sitting between K and R.

3) L is just behind P.

As L is just behind P, therefore P is sitting in the first row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23fb6aa8da4e20b91203c55038a719087a75b80589947b5a7f6db4860914f343.png] 

4) O is between L and M. 

5) O is to the immediate left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72a380703e6285ec6484817a141ea8249ada96880dcee45169008fa17bdfc436.png] 

6) N is not in the front line.

As after positioning N only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bd23e6684b92aaaecf6a084fd499674eb7e685b08cf9f814b35ea853096875e.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Q is sitting between P and R.

Hence, **"Q"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K U _ _ N K _ Q P _ _ U _ P N
questions.solution:
Given : K U _ _ N K _ Q P _ _ U _ P N

By checking options :

 
• QPUNKQ → K U __**Q**__ __**P**__ N K __**U**__ Q P __**N**__ __**K**__ U __**Q**__ P N → (It follows the pattern of : KUQPN - KUQPN - KUQPN)
 
• QPUNQK → K U __Q__ __P__ N K __U__ Q P __N__ **__Q__** U **__K__** P N → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• QQPUNK → K U __Q__ **__Q__** N K **__P__** Q P **__U__** **__N__** U **__K__** P N → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• QUPQNK → K U __Q__ **__U__** N K **__P__** Q P **__Q__** **__N__** U **__K__** P N → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of " K U __Q__ __P__ N - K __U__ Q P __N__ - __K__ U __Q__ P N "

Hence, **"QPUNKQ"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some roses are pansies.

Some lilies are pansies.

All roses are daisies.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some roses are lilies.

II. All pansies are daisies.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/261b3df0daec0e92ef66a1995a52a95e064543716fa1121c22229fa8aed4d2e5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some roses are lilies → Does not follow (As some roses are pansies, some lilies are pansies. So, some roses are lilies is possible but not definitely true)

II. All pansies are daisies → Does not follow (As some roses are pansies, all roses are daisies. So, all pansies are daisies is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion I nor II follows****"**.

questions.question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/864251f2b12faecf0d0e2294605c638348a423dfa3d7cbfa10e09ec7794dda25.png]

⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• D → F
 
• E → H
 
• C → G

Therefore,

 
• Option(1) → E and D ⇒ Not opposite (As E is opposite to H and D is opposite to F)
 
• Option(2) → E and H ⇒ Opposite
 
• Option(3) → C and F ⇒ Not opposite (As C is opposite to G and F is opposite to D) 
 
• Option(4) → C and H ⇒ Not opposite (As C is opposite to G and H is opposite to F)

Hence, "**E and H**" is the correct answer.
